The corrected timeline preserves all 98 original media items and the identities and styles of all 390 text effects. 镂孔黄铜飞轮匀速旋转，带动暗红连杆与银色摇杆往复摆动。零件尺寸、轴向分层、孔轴位: The perforated brass flywheel rotates at a constant speed, driving the dark red connecting rod and silver rocker back and forth. Part dimensions, axial layering, hole and shaft positions, and native keyframes can all be inspected and edited further.
用明确的几何约束组织一件精致机械演示，将参数CAD、原生场景与实际影片连接成可复: Use explicit geometric constraints to organize a refined mechanical demonstration, connecting parametric CAD, native scenes and an actual film into a reusable production pipeline.
通过真实DCC-MCP制作一件黄铜四杆演示仪。固定轴间距70毫米、输入半径25毫: Use real DCC-MCP to create a brass four-bar demonstration instrument. Set the fixed shaft spacing to 70 mm, the input radius to 25 mm, the connecting rod to 80 mm and the rocker to 50 mm. First build editable parts and real through-holes natively in FreeCAD, checking for valid closed solids; map the actual STL data into Blender by dividing millimeters by 20. Use brass, dark red, silver, ivory and dark gray for clear materials, bevels, lighting and native text. Calculate the pivot positions for every frame from the same geometric solution, and verify native matrices, keyframe values, and save/reopen. Render 96 frames for one full cycle and edit them into an 18-second demonstration in Kdenlive, clearly distinguishing the continuously rotating input from the oscillating output. Preserve native projects, before-and-after improvements, actual MCP evidence, versions, licenses and relocation acceptance checks; do not claim dynamics or manufacturing validation.
